main_text.p: autem Sirmium oppidum Pannoniæ, Illyrico conterminæ, ad Saum amnem in Europa, vt ait Plinius lib.3. cap.25. Smyrna verò Ioniæ vel potius Æoliæ ciuitas ad mare sita, in minori Asia, vt idem Plinius docet libr.5. cap.29. Cœpit hæc hæresis ísto Photinianorum nomine innotescere, etiam ante Nicenam Synodum, quando in ea istorum mentio facta est, vt apparet ex Ruffini historia: sed tamen quia nondum inualuerat, collocatur prima illius origo sub Constantio imperatore, & Liberio episcopo Romano, circa annum à passo Christo 323. cuius scintillæ Sirmij primum accensæ in Asiam, & reliquas orbis regiones magna incendia postea pepererunt. Itaque latissime statim sparsus est hic error, cuius immani fœtore offensi Patres orthodoxi Sirmium conuenerunt, ibíque cum communibus sententiis damnarunt, Photino ipso audito, & à Basilio Ancyræ episcopo erroris conuicto, vt tradit Socrates libro 2. capite 29,&30. tamen ad imperatorem prouocauit, apud quem neque causam suam approbare, neque obtinere potuit. Itaque Sardicensi Synodo iterum damnatus, & ab Arianis ipsis explosus est, & vt blasphemus reiectus, quemadmodum scribit Sozomen. libro 4. capite 6. tam teter nimirum & grauis habitus est vel solus iftius erroris cdor, vt ne ab hæreticis quidem ipsis sustineri posset. Certè in constitutione Iustiniani lib.1.Codicis inter capitales fidei Christianæ hostes Photiniani enumerantur. Et quum sub Theodosio maiore variis hæresibus suas synaxes habere concessum esset, vt scribit Socrates

page.notes: Printed page has an extra running-title style "Cap.45." at top left, read as a chapter marker; the page number is recorded there. The last line is cut off at the foot, where the catchword "crates" is printed below the last line at right: it is included as the continuation word and not as a separate paragraph. Some words in the lower half are slightly blurred ("ibíque", "cdor", "sustineri") and are copied as best read; the line "neque obtinere potuit" is clear. The word "ipsis" in "Arianis ipsis" is clear. Possible printing errors left as printed: "scintillæ", "Saum" (likely Savum), "cdor", "suam" line as printed. The scan shows a faint mark at the left margin around the "Smyrna" line, not text.
